main_text.p: עבף עבוּפְיָא, עבוּף Ch. Viride, Frondosum. עָבֵץ Ch. Stánum, Idem quod אֲבַץ, Ezech.27.12. vel ע בְּעִיץ & ב transpositis. עבר Ch. & Syr. Transfire, transgredi, praeterire: Item Ch. Gravidam esse, gravida fieri, concipere. Aphel אַעְבַּר Transfire facere, traducere, transmittere, transferre, transvehere, transponere: Mutare: Item Repagulare, repagulo vel pessulo praeludere, 1.Reg.6.21. Pahel עַבַּר Gravidam, praegnantem esse: Item Gravidare, impraegnare, gravidam reddere: Item Intercalare, Cantic.7.4. Ithpahel אִתְעַבַּר Transfiri: Item Concipere.

עִבְרָא, עִבְרָא, עֲבַר, עֲבַר, עָבָר Chald. & Syr. Trans, ultra: Contra, E regione, Ex adverso: & Nominaliter, prout formam habet Nominis & Praepositionis, Transitus: Latus, מֵעֵבְרָא דִיכִי A' latere illo, 1.Sam. 14.2. Plur. עִבְרִי, עִבְרִין: עִבְרִין Ab ulterioribus partibus, à finibus terrae, Matth.12.42. Luc.11.31.
עִבְרְתָא, עֲבִירָא Ch. Transgresio, iniquitas, peccatum: Plur. חַמֵּשׁ עֲבִירִין Quinque transgressiones commisit in die illo, Genes.25.29. in Jon.
עִבְרָאֵי עִבְרָאֵה Chald. Hebraeus. Plur. עִבְרָאֵין, עִבְרָאֵי; Syr. ܥܒܪܝܐ, Act.6.1. Foem. עִבְרָיְתָא, עִבְרָאֵה Hebraea.
עִבּוּרָא עִבּוּר Ch. Syr. Proventus, annona, fructus, frumentum, praeteriti sc. anni: Deinde Ch. Intercalatio, Embolismus, ἐμβολισμὸς: Item Coceptus, Gravi-

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee, Syriac and Greek forms are transcribed approximately from a small, faint scan; vowel points and diacritics in the Hebrew and Syriac lines are uncertain and marked by my reading rather than exact letters. The Syriac and Hebrew word forms in the lines beginning "Syr. Hebraicè" and "Ch. Syr. Proventus" are doubtful.
